code_change: crates/om9-app/src/session/layers.rs::assign_layer: after resolving the target layer and before applying any LayerAction, a locked target is refused with Error::Permission("layer is locked"); the refusal costs no transaction and leaves the objects where they were.
No other behaviour changed: create+current in one batch, assignment not stealing the current layer and the empty-selection no-op already held.

manual_reviewer_checklist.scope_note: The rules are machine-proven; the panel reading and the feel of the assignment are yours to confirm. One open question is recorded in api.md: making a LOCKED layer current is currently refused; this item does not change that rule and its oracle does not mention it.

items.step: Click a Metals row to make it current.
items.machine_proven: C1/C3: the preset layer is created and made current in one call, and the panel's current id equals document.current_layer.
items.human_must_verify: The clicked row is highlighted, the status line names it, and clicking another row moves the highlight.

items.step: Select an object and assign it to another layer (e.g. Gems).
items.machine_proven: C2: one transaction moves the objects, and the current layer does not move with them.
items.human_must_verify: The object's colour/row changes to the target layer, Undo reverses it in one step, and the current layer stays where it was.

items.step: Lock Gems, then try to assign an object to it.
items.machine_proven: L1/L2: the assignment is refused before anything is applied, with 'layer is locked', and the journal does not move.
items.human_must_verify: Nothing moves, the status explains the refusal, and Undo is not needed to get back.

items.machine_proven: L3: it is a no-op that succeeds and adds no journal entry.
items.human_must_verify: No error dialog, no phantom undo entry.

items.step: Create a layer through the CMD line (Layer 5 / Layer Gems) and look at the palette.
items.machine_proven: the CMD path resolves a slot number, a preset name and a quoted label to one slot, refusing an ambiguous quoted label.
items.human_must_verify: The new row appears in the right group with the manual's colour, and a repeated name is refused rather than guessed.
